title: Unbounded evaluation and coefficient comparison before descent
statement: Fix an ordinary strict-system image package S and normalized derived evaluation-extension packages PY and PX as in [def-pur-coefficient-system-image-data]. There exist normalized exact inverse images and total right-derived direct images on the system and level categories, with their K-injective computation and strict-map transpose formulas, and canonical evaluation, ordinary tensor, derived tensor, scalar-restriction and transition comparisons, including all representative, unit, counit and adjunction-mate equations. This is precisely the seventeen construction projections of CoefficientSystemDerivedImage, before joint conservativity, lower-bound preservation and the essential-image/normalization descent criterion. It asserts the unbounded comparison for all derived objects, independently of a bounded-below full-faithfulness hypothesis.

source.place: Zheng Construction 4.1 and Lemma 4.10, equation (4.10.1), via the derived left-extension Hom chain; original comparison proof steps 1–8.

proof.text: The given ordinary package S already supplies exact inverse image, the level and system right adjoints, and the normalized ordinary adjunctions. Present its target strict-system category as modules on the small ringed sequence site. Apply K-injective resolution existence there, and at each level. Exact inverse image descends by localization; total right-derived direct image is constructed by K-injective resolutions. The derived adjunctions come from the given ordinary ones.

Fix the canonical derived adjunctions, including their units and counits, using [lem-weil-pbc-termwise-adjunction-homotopy, lem-pc-pre-derived-adjoint-functors-general]. The first gives the termwise adjunction on homotopy categories; the second gives its localized Hom bijection with the following normalization. For a right resolution $s:K\to I$, a left resolution $t:P\to H$, and $f:P\to F_hI$, it sends the fraction $p_sQ'(f)Q'(t)^{-1}$ to $Q(s)^{-1}Q(a_h(f))u_t$. Here $p_s$ and $u_t$ are the right- and left-derived resolution comparisons and $a_h$ is the underived transpose on homotopy categories. Step 1 supplies the everywhere-defined derived functors for the system and level inverse-image/direct-image pairs; exact inverse image needs no left resolution. Thus their Hom bijections are obtained from the ordinary module transposes with precisely this normalization, rather than from unspecified choices of adjunction on the derived functors.

Use $LE_n\dashv e_n$ and its strict tensor model from [lem-pur-coefficient-evaluation-derived-left-adjoint]. Choose a flat-term K-flat resolution $P\to N$ over $A_n$ by [lem-pc-kflat-resolution]. The coefficient-$A_n$ inverse image sends $P$ to a flat-term K-flat complex by [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-pullback-preserves-kflat]. In the two strict system complexes $u_A^*E_nP$ and $E_n(u_n^*P)$ the components above $n$ are zero, and at $q\leq n$ the tensor comparison is $u^*(P\otimes_{A_n}A_q)\cong u^*P\otimes_{A_n}A_q$. Since $A_q=A_n/\lambda^qA_n$, the term $P^r\otimes_{A_n}A_q$ is the cokernel of multiplication by $\lambda^q$ on $P^r$, and the exact inverse image of step 1 preserves this cokernel; so the degreewise comparison is already an isomorphism of sheaves before deriving. These comparisons are the canonical pullback/tensor maps of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback], with the second factor the constant quotient ring; they preserve its $A_q$ action. On local tensor generators the map carries $x\otimes a$ to the corresponding pulled-back generator $u^*x\otimes a$. Reducing $a$ to a lower quotient commutes with this formula. Thus the comparisons define an isomorphism of strict complexes of systems, natural in $P$ and its maps, and descend via the resolution model to $u_A^*LE_n^{\mathcal Y}\cong LE_n^{\mathcal X}u_n^*$.

For the separate coefficient-change assertion, take a flat-term K-flat resolution $Q\to N$ over $A_m$ by [lem-pc-kflat-resolution]. Pulling back $Q$ preserves these properties by [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-pullback-preserves-kflat], and tensoring $Q$ with $A_n$ computes its derived scalar extension. Exact inverse image therefore represents the left-hand side by $u_n^*(Q\otimes_{A_m}A_n)$, and the right-hand side by $u_m^*Q\otimes_{A_m}A_n$. The natural degreewise pullback/tensor map identifies these complexes as $A_n$-complexes and commutes with their differentials and maps of resolutions. It induces $u_n^*(N\otimes^L_{A_m}A_n)\cong u_m^*N\otimes^L_{A_m}A_n$ for every $m\geq n$; no flatness of $A_n$ over $A_m$ is used.

For $N\in D(\mathcal Y,A_n)$ and $M\in D(\mathsf S_A(\mathcal X))$, form the natural chain of bijections
$$\operatorname{Hom}(N,e_nRu_{A,*}M)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(LE_n^{\mathcal Y}N,Ru_{A,*}M)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(u_A^*LE_n^{\mathcal Y}N,M)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(LE_n^{\mathcal X}u_n^*N,M)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(u_n^*N,e_nM)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(N,Ru_{n,*}e_nM).$$
The outer evaluation adjunctions are [lem-pur-coefficient-evaluation-derived-left-adjoint], the direct-image adjunctions were established in steps 1–2 using [lem-pc-derived-adjoint-functors], and the middle isomorphism is step 3. The Yoneda bijection [lem-galois-yoneda-fully-faithful] turns this into a natural isomorphism $\beta_n:e_nRu_{A,*}\cong Ru_{n,*}e_n$. In particular this argument proves the unbounded comparison without asserting that evaluation preserves K-injectives in the varying-ring system category. The pullback comparison $e_nu_A^*\cong u_n^*e_n$ is already the termwise identity of step 1.

Write $\eta^A,\varepsilon^A$ for the system adjunction and $\eta^n,\varepsilon^n$ for the level adjunction. The comparison of step 3 has the identity as its $n$-th component under $e_nLE_n\cong\mathrm{id}$, and hence preserves the evaluation-adjunction unit. The normalized Hom bijections in step 2 and [lem-pur-coefficient-evaluation-derived-left-adjoint] therefore identify the Hom chain of step 5 with transposing the evaluated system counit $e_n\varepsilon^A_M$. Equivalently its Yoneda isomorphism $\beta_n$ satisfies
$$\varepsilon^n_{e_nM}\,u_n^*\beta_{n,M}=e_n\varepsilon^A_M.$$
For the unit, substitute $u_A^*H$ for $M$ in this equality and compose with $u_n^*e_n\eta^A_H$. The system triangle identity makes the result the identity of $u_n^*e_nH$. By the level adjunction, the unique map whose transpose is this identity is $\eta^n_{e_nH}$. Thus
$$\beta_{n,u_A^*H}\,e_n\eta^A_H=\eta^n_{e_nH}.$$
These are the required evaluated counit and unit identities, natural in the input derived systems.

For each quotient $A_m\to A_n$, apply [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-module-adjunction] to the identity topos with this structural ring map: ordinary tensor extension is left adjoint to coefficient restriction. Restriction is exact because it leaves the underlying abelian sheaf unchanged [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. Its derived functor is consequently itself by [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-functor]. Left derived extension exists everywhere by [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], so [lem-pc-derived-adjoint-functors] gives $C_{mn}=-\otimes^L_{A_m}A_n\dashv\operatorname{Res}_{A_m\to A_n}$ on the unbounded categories. The normalization is the fraction-transpose formula of step 2. Applying [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition] to the identity ringed topos and $u$ identifies
$$Ru_{m,*}\operatorname{Res}_{A_m\to A_n}\cong\operatorname{Res}_{A_m\to A_n}Ru_{n,*}.$$
Indeed the underlying composites of ringed-topos morphisms agree: both use $u^{-1}(A_m)\to u^{-1}(A_n)=A_n$. Thus the two possible restricted direct-image routes in a quotient square have canonically identified target coefficient categories.

To check quotient compatibility, use $\sigma_{mn}:LE_nC_{mn}\to LE_m$ from [lem-pur-coefficient-evaluation-derived-left-adjoint]. Its precomposition action is explicitly $h\mapsto t^M_{mn}\circ C_{mn}(h)$, where $t^M_{mn}$ is the adjoint transition of a system. The tensor comparison of step 3 commutes with $\sigma_{mn}$: on a common flat-term K-flat complex its components at $q\leq n$ are the pullback/tensor map on both routes, and at $q>n$ both maps have zero source. Hence the Hom chain of step 5 commutes with precomposition by $\sigma_{mn}$. Under the stated mate formula this says exactly that $\beta_m,\beta_n$ respect the transitions $M_m\to\operatorname{Res}_{A_m\to A_n}M_n$, with the coefficient/direct-image comparison of step 7 understood. Every Hom bijection is natural in the input derived system, so the square also commutes for every morphism of input systems. Identity and composition of quotients follow from the corresponding asserted identities for $\sigma_{mn}$; no choices of separate levelwise lifts are used.
